images.filename: Rahkeem Cornwall collects first-ever CPL century.png
images.caption:
What an unforgettable night it was for the fans at the Kensington Oval, who were treated to a double delight: a stunning victory for the Royals and Rahkeem Cornwall's first-ever CPL century!
The Barbados Royals accomplished a remarkable chase, reaching the challenging target of 220 set by the St Kitts and Nevis Patriots, doing so with style, amassing a total of 220/2.
Nevertheless, the real star of the night was none other than 'Big Rahk' himself, as Cornwall unleashed a spectacular performance, remaining unbeaten with an incredible 102 from 48 deliveries, coloured by 12 sixes and 4 fours.

📸: Rawle Toney
